description: Manually reviewed ATT&CK labels for 50 Sigma rules. Labels were checked against each rule's title, description, detection logic, and ATT&CK technique semantics.

rules.title: 7Zip Compressing Dump Files
rules.note: 7-Zip archives a memory dump before collection/exfiltration.

rules.title: Windows AMSI Related Registry Tampering Via CommandLine
rules.note: Registry changes disable or modify AMSI protection.

rules.title: Suspicious ArcSOC.exe Child Process
rules.note: Suspicious script/interpreter child process started by ArcSOC.

rules.title: Potential Adplus.EXE Abuse
rules.note: Adplus creates a process memory dump that can contain LSASS credentials.

rules.title: Hiding Files with Attrib.exe
rules.note: Attrib sets hidden/system attributes to conceal files.

rules.title: Audit Policy Tampering Via Auditpol
rules.note: Auditpol changes or clears Windows audit policy.

rules.title: Suspicious Download Via Certutil.EXE
rules.note: Certutil downloads content and can encode/obfuscate it.

rules.title: Suspicious Ping/Del Command Combination
rules.note: Del removes files, often after a timing delay from ping.

rules.title: HackTool - Mimikatz Execution
rules.note: Mimikatz exposes LSASS, SAM, LSA, cached domain, and DCSync credential access.

rules.title: PowerShell Download and Execution Cradles
rules.note: PowerShell executes a download-and-run cradle.

rules.title: PowerShell Download Pattern
rules.note: PowerShell command line contains download primitives.

rules.title: Scheduled Task Creation Via Schtasks.EXE
rules.note: Schtasks creates a scheduled task for execution or persistence.

rules.title: Computer System Reconnaissance Via Wmic.EXE
rules.note: WMI is used to query host information via WMIC.

rules.title: Powerview Add-DomainObjectAcl DCSync AD Extend Right
rules.note: ACL modification grants replication rights used for DCSync.

rules.title: Active Directory Replication from Non Machine Account - DcSync Indicator
rules.note: Directory replication from a non-machine account indicates DCSync.

rules.title: Access To ADMIN$ Network Share
rules.note: SMB/Windows Admin Shares are accessed remotely.

rules.title: Security Eventlog Cleared
rules.note: The Security event log is cleared to remove evidence.

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Explicit Credential Local Logon
rules.note: Explicit credentials are used to create a logon token, including make-and-impersonate-token behavior.

rules.title: Windows Event Log Access Tampering Via Registry
rules.note: Registry modification tampers with event log access and can establish autostart persistence.

rules.title: New RUN Key Pointing to Suspicious Folder
rules.note: A Run key autostart entry is created from a suspicious folder.

rules.title: Suspicious Renamed Comsvcs DLL Loaded By Rundll32
rules.note: A renamed comsvcs.dll is used through Rundll32 to dump LSASS memory.

rules.title: Vulnerable Driver Load
rules.note: A vulnerable driver is loaded and can be used for privilege escalation or persistent kernel access.

rules.title: Suspicious Cobalt Strike DNS Beaconing - Sysmon
rules.note: DNS queries carry command-and-control traffic.

rules.title: Process Initiated Network Connection To Ngrok Domain
rules.note: Ngrok provides a web service tunnel that can relay C2 or exfiltration traffic.

rules.title: HackTool - CrackMapExec File Indicators
rules.note: CrackMapExec file artifacts are associated with credential dumping.

rules.title: Scheduled Task/Job At
rules.note: The at utility schedules a command or job.

rules.title: Audit Rules Deleted Via Auditctl
rules.note: Auditctl removes audit rules to impair logging.

rules.title: Linux Base64 Encoded Pipe to Shell
rules.note: Base64 content is decoded and piped to a shell.

rules.title: Linux Logs Clearing Attempts
rules.note: System and authentication logs are deleted.

rules.title: Crontab Enumeration
rules.note: Cron and service configuration are enumerated.

rules.title: MacOS Scripting Interpreter AppleScript
rules.note: AppleScript executes commands through osascript.

rules.title: Hidden User Creation
rules.note: A local account is created with a hidden identity attribute.

rules.title: Credentials from Password Stores - Keychain
rules.note: Credentials are read from the macOS Keychain.

rules.title: Disable Security Tools
rules.note: Security tooling is stopped or disabled.

rules.title: AWS ConsoleLogin Failed Authentication
rules.note: Repeated failed console authentication indicates brute force or password guessing.

rules.title: AWS CloudTrail Important Change
rules.note: CloudTrail logging is disabled or modified.

rules.title: Malicious Usage Of IMDS Credentials Outside Of AWS Infrastructure
rules.note: Valid cloud instance credentials obtained from IMDS are used outside AWS.

rules.title: Discovery Using AzureHound
rules.note: AzureHound enumerates cloud accounts and cloud service discovery.

rules.title: Potential MFA Bypass Using Legacy Client Authentication
rules.note: Legacy authentication attempts bypass MFA while using or guessing cloud accounts.

rules.title: Potential PetitPotam Attack Via EFS RPC Calls
rules.note: EFS RPC coercion captures authentication traffic for credential relay.

rules.title: DNS TOR Proxies
rules.note: DNS traffic to Tor proxy infrastructure can carry exfiltration.

rules.title: Executable from Webdav
rules.note: An executable is transferred from WebDAV.

rules.title: Remote Task Creation via ATSVC Named Pipe - Zeek
rules.note: A remote scheduled task is created through the ATSVC named pipe.

rules.title: Okta FastPass Phishing Detection
rules.note: A phishing attempt targets Okta FastPass authentication.

rules.title: Okta Admin Role Assigned to an User or Group
rules.note: An additional cloud role is assigned to an Okta principal.

rules.title: New Github Organization Member Added
rules.note: A new cloud account/member is added to the organization.

rules.title: Github Push Protection Bypass Detected
rules.note: A repository security control is bypassed.

rules.title: Github Repository/Organization Transferred
rules.note: Repository or organization ownership is transferred to another account.

rules.title: Bitbucket Global SSH Settings Changed
rules.note: SSH access settings are modified, affecting remote access and security controls.

rules.title: Remote DCOM/WMI Lateral Movement
rules.note: Remote DCOM/WMI RPC traffic is used for lateral execution.
